train_reward_model: train a reward model using TRL RewardTrainer with chosen and rejected text pairs
configure_peft_lora: configure LoRA parameters for PEFT fine-tuning of a reward model with int4 or int8 quantization
preprocess_reward_data: preprocess reward training data by tokenizing chosen and rejected pairs and filtering by block size
load_sequence_classification_model: load a pretrained sequence classification model from HuggingFace with optional BitsAndBytes quantization
setup_reward_trainer: setup a TRL RewardTrainer with model, tokenizer, training dataset, and PEFT configuration
